protocol_acceptance: Prospective amendment awaiting exact technical receipts and delegated AI research-lead acceptance; literal human review remains not_run and is not relabelled as passed.
question: For the four fixed semantic variants of two independent source families, how does initial presentation of the permitted source assets change full-contract migration quality and provider-reported whole-Run tokens under serial execution?
intervention: Initial source-asset presentation only; both arms retain identical readable source/data and tool access. No self-verification or retention intervention is combined.
primary_outcomes: all-assigned mean provider-reported input-plus-output tokens per Run difference
claim: Estimate differences conditional on the two selected fixed source families and their two variants, equally weighted by family and variant, under the observed provider/day/session regime. No quality-maintenance, noninferiority, universal migration, billing-truth or mechanism-proof claim.
experimental_unit: Assigned Run with immutable instance; presentation arm is assigned within each paired block.
analysis_unit: Within-variant paired block, equal weight across source families and across each family's two fixed semantic variants. Repeated Runs and same-family variants are not new independent source applications.

regime.pair_completion_gate: Reviewed public subset, verified independent download/restore and owned scratch cleanup before next pair.
regime.cache_policy: Fresh Run workspace/state/session; retain provider-side cache as naturally encountered on the unchanged account. No cache purge or account rotation.
regime.interference_limit: Serial execution avoids simultaneous arm load but does not remove carry-over provider cache, quota, day or session effects. Balanced random order estimates the effect under this policy, not under a no-cache counterfactual. Paired technical evidence is separate and never pooled.

allocation.selection_rule: Frozen before all new research model outcomes. Two materially independent source families selected for executed source/data continuity, not model-success screening. Four variants nested in those families receive 16 paired repetitions each, 64 pairs total. The overall normal half-width is approximately 0.173 at discordance 0.5 under independent paired observations; per-variant half-width is approximately 0.346. Two fixed families do not establish representativeness or estimate a random across-application population reliably.

development_and_heldout.heldout_definition: Reserved before comparative model outcomes. Source, independently derived oracle and compatibility references are inspected and finite-calibrated for basic apparatus acceptance. This is outcome-held-out research-family membership, not sealed source/oracle secrecy or a claim of contamination elimination. No task/profile adaptation after research outcomes.
development_and_heldout.independent_task_confirmation: fixed-family exploratory comparison; no universal population confirmation

measurement.usage_boundary: All gateway-observed main/auxiliary model calls within an assigned Run. Input plus output once; cached input remains within input and reasoning within output.
measurement.time_boundary: Implementation starts with ordinary controller execution and ends with confirmed owned worker/gateway stop. Barrier waiting/postprocessing/publication are separately recorded and never reset or added to the 1800-second budget.
measurement.provider_truth: Provider-reported token counts, not independently known internal accounting or monetary cost.

missingness.assigned_denominator: All 128 slots, including undispatched, uncertain, infrastructure failure, product failure, timeout, evaluator fault and incomplete coverage. Report state counts per arm/variant and actual dispatch count.
missingness.quality: A confirmed critical/product failure is a failure even when other coverage is incomplete. Full pass requires complete frozen HTTP/browser/data checks. Otherwise unknown, not zero/failure/pass. Report per-arm pass bounds and paired-contrast identification bounds by propagating unknown binary values.
missingness.usage: Complete totals are null unless complete inventory and provider input/output accounting are established. Preserve deduplicated observed partial amounts separately. Call/Run totals are not established by saved response or DONE alone.
missingness.partial_lower_bound: Label a lower bound only if receipt verifies nonnegative cumulative token semantics, unique-call identity, monotonic reported usage and complete reconciliation for every included call. Otherwise call it an observed partial amount only.
missingness.all_assigned_token_identification: Without complete totals or an externally justified upper bound, the all-assigned mean token contrast is not identified. Wall-clock/output context settings do not impose a valid whole-Run token upper bound. Report this explicitly.
missingness.sensitivity: As labeled assumptions only, impute each missing arm/variant total as 0.5, 1 or 2 times that arm/variant observed complete-Run mean. Show the full crossed-arm scenario range. If no complete mean exists, do not compute that scenario. Complete-pair and success-only estimates remain secondary; no replacement Runs.

analysis.weighting: Equal variant weight, then equal assigned pair weight within variant.
analysis.uncertainty: Report per-variant and per-fixed-family paired estimates, overall family/variant weighted estimate and 95% paired uncertainty. Fully observed binary outcomes use a conservative Hoeffding interval under stated independence plus normal session ICC sensitivity 0,0.1,0.3. Four consecutive assigned pairs define sessions; retain actual dates/timestamps. The two selected fixed source families do not identify a general application population or a reliable random-family variance.
analysis.multiplicity: Descriptive co-primary estimates; no joint success flag or significance-based selection. Any interval excluding zero supports only the named outcome under its assumptions.
analysis.provider_change: Record model/HTTP/model-metadata changes. Unexpected model stops dispatch; changed provider behavior creates an amendment/new cohort rather than unlabelled pooling.

stop_rules.completion: Stop after all assigned slots reach documented terminal/uncertain states and completed-pair gates; no outcome-driven N change.
stop_rules.infrastructure: Pause new dispatch on provider/auth/storage/identity/serialization/ownership/stop-confirmation fault. Preserve all evidence and reconcile affected instances. Do not resend an uncertain or previously dispatched slot.
stop_rules.product_failure: Retain as a valid observation; it does not justify replacement or extra Runs.
stop_rules.quota: Use existing account/no-paid-overage policy; pause on unavailability, no model/account fallback and no guarantee of completion within a billing period.
stop_rules.resume: Only unsent slots after explicit recovery, unchanged plan/assets and exact-plan user start authorization. A partial pair is not an excuse to replay its sent slot.

historical_data.old_100_pairs: Preserve original protocol, raw records, verdicts, assignments and ZIP; exploratory/diagnostic role only.
historical_data.technical_cohorts: Distinct IDs and storage; excluded from all research estimates.

start_conditions: #22 selected reference/oracle/data contract accepted for this narrow scope
#22 materially independent task set and pre-outcome development/held-out memberships accepted

#21 and #22 delegated research-lead acceptance on exact bound assets, with user delegation, ordinary workflow/source-oracle evidence and independent methodological review; human_review remains not_run
Immutable final code/runtime/input/evaluator/browser/environment and assignments bound in new bundle
No-model preflight passes without credential read or model dispatch
Separate user start instruction bound to exact frozen plan
selection_amendment_basis: A second independent education family was added to implement the current Issue #22 scope after the parent explicitly required completing the task set. Selection uses source provenance, meaningful source/data continuity and reference feasibility. No new research outcomes exist, and technical outcomes are not used to select tasks or increase the fixed 64-pair/128-slot cap.
protocol_revision: Prospective acceptance-policy amendment only, before any research dispatch. Scientific tasks, source intervention, allocation, settings, measurement, analysis, evaluator, collection and stop rules remain identical to v3. User delegation requires bound research-lead, ordinary workflow/source-oracle and independent methodological evidence. Human and ordinary-user acceptance are not claimed.

submission_collection.static_database_assets: Regular .sqlite/.sqlite3/.db files in the final workspace are submitted assets; never infer eligibility from a restricted MSBuild syntax or raw-input byte equality.
submission_collection.unclosed_sidecars: Associated nonempty SQLite WAL/SHM/journal leaves collection unconfirmed; no automatic checkpoint, data rewrite or silent dropping of an asset.
submission_collection.frozen_identity: All regular frozen files, including static databases, use the SDK directory-exclusion identity algorithm. Workspace collection selection is a separate operation.
submission_collection.legacy_compatibility: Conditions without opt-in keep legacy-v1 collection. Old frozen submissions and original verdicts are unchanged; lost historical files are not reconstructed.
submission_collection.public_subset: Existing partial public evidence slice explicitly omits databases with inventory hashes/reasons; it does not promise runnable submission/evaluator replay.
